title: Concurrent worker failures are not captured with their original exceptions
reasoning: The thread worker only puts successful results into the queue. If BookmarkCacheManager.get_bookmarks_for_objects raises inside a thread, the main test later fails on missing queue entries or even on aggregate calculations, but it does not preserve the original exception and traceback as first-class test data. Depending on pytest warning settings, the actionable failure can be obscured.
recommendation: Wrap worker logic in try/except, put exceptions and tracebacks into the queue, and have the main thread fail explicitly if any worker reports an error before calculating aggregate timings.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The concurrent test checks only result counts and timing; it has no assertion path that reports worker exceptions directly.
suggestedRegressionTest: Introduce a temporary failing worker or mock BookmarkCacheManager.get_bookmarks_for_objects to raise in one thread and assert the test reports that exception explicitly.
minimumFixScope: Modify the worker/result collection logic in test_concurrent_cache_operations to carry either success records or exception records back to the main thread.
